rewrites.rewritten_text: Nestled in the heart of LoHi, this charming 2-story townhome offers a perfect blend of modern living and historic charm. The Lower Highland area, known for its trendy restaurants, bars, and young-professional density, is rich in character with its Victorian homes and modern townhomes. This meticulously maintained home boasts high ceilings, sunlit rooms, and the warmth of hardwood floors in an open floorplan designed for both everyday living and entertaining. Turnkey, remodeled, and updated, the bright kitchen offers abundant cabinetry, granite counters, and opens to the living/family room with a cozy fireplace. The private backyard retreat is a gardener's dream, perfect for morning coffee, birdsong, and fragrant blooms in the perennial garden—surrounded by mature trees with skyline views to the east. The main-level primary suite was remodeled with an oversized walk-in shower, double sinks, granite counters, and a walk-in custom closet. The main level also features a study and laundry. Upstairs, two additional bedrooms and a full guest bath. The finished basement expands living space with a media area and large recreation room—high ceilings, great lighting, and flex space ideal for dual home offices combined with a 4th bedroom, or a spacious private guest suite. Roof 2024, newer HVAC. This beautiful place is a haven for wildlife, including foxes, bunnies, and countless bird species. Just a block from the neighborhood lookout deck and miles of scenic trails, parks, and the LoHi community center for pool, tennis, and more. Minutes to shopping, local favorites, parks, and open space. Step back in time—downtown Denver with great shops, dining, and events. Within minutes, you'll find Sw Plaza, small boutiques, dining, seasonal farmers markets, a dog park, and Linger rooftop in the old mortuary with sweeping skyline views. Recognized as one of America's top cities to live in, LoHi blends small-town charm with convenience while preserving natural beauty and peaceful surroundings in an active community.

Nestled in the trendy LoHi neighborhood of Denver, this modern townhome offers over 4,000 square feet of contemporary living steps from Little Man Ice Cream and Linger rooftop bar. Built in 2018, this five-bedroom, five-bath residence combines functional design with elevated finishes and exceptional community amenities. The open-concept main level features a private office, vaulted great room with fireplace, and a spacious kitchen designed for both everyday living and entertaining. Highlights include stainless steel appliances, a farmhouse sink, generous prep space, and seamless flow to the dining and living areas. Electronic shades, organized closet systems, and curated upgrades throughout contribute to the home's polished, turnkey feel. Upstairs, the primary suite includes a four-piece bath and professionally fitted walk-in closet, alongside three additional bedrooms. The finished basement expands the home's versatility with a large recreation and entertainment space, wine fridge, ensuite guest bedroom, and dedicated professional gym. Outdoor living is equally inviting with a covered patio and lush landscaping designed for low-maintenance enjoyment. The oversized two-car garage includes an additional storage bay ideal for bikes, outdoor gear, or workshop space. Residents of LoHi enjoy access to the Highland Bridge, skyline views, trendy restaurants, and a vibrant young-professional community just moments from downtown Denver.

Designed with a refined Scandinavian influence, this custom new construction residence introduces a full custom sophisticated modern aesthetic to Denver's LoHi neighborhood. The lower level continues the home's tailored approach with tall ceilings, two secondary bedrooms, a three-quarter bath, and a custom built-in dry bar.

Nestled in the trendy LoHi neighborhood, this contemporary 2006-built townhome offers a rare opportunity in one of Denver's most sought-after areas. 3,026 finished square feet above grade plus a 1,598 sqft basement with 9-foot ceilings ready to finish to taste. Three bedrooms, three full baths, and a dedicated main-floor home office. A dramatic two-story foyer opens to a flowing main level defined by elegant arched openings, rich hardwood floors, and a kitchen with quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances, and a center island—open to an expansive living room anchored by a stacked-stone gas fireplace and sliding glass doors to the deck. A separate dining room, dedicated laundry, and built-in mudroom round out daily living. Brand new carpet leads upstairs to an exceptional primary retreat: a king-sized bedroom with private sitting area, walk-in closet, spacious 5-piece en-suite bath, and a covered private balcony. Two additional bedrooms share a full bath. Recent improvements include a high-efficiency furnace installed November 2023 and central A/C in excellent working order. Location is unbeatable: walkable to Little Man Ice Cream, Linger rooftop, and the pedestrian Highland Bridge to downtown; minutes to trendy restaurants, bars, and everyday retail. Quick access to I-25 and I-70 makes the mountains an easy weekend escape. HOA dues $85/month cover entrance landscaping and upkeep. A great home as-is at this price—with the opportunity to add meaningful equity through modernized finishes and a future basement build-out in a neighborhood where homes of this size at this price point simply do not exist.

Located near parks, trails, shopping, dining, and mere steps away from the iconic Little Man Ice Cream and Linger rooftop, this home is perfectly situated in the heart of LoHi.

Experience effortless single-level living in this beautifully updated brick ranch, centrally situated in Denver's rapidly gentrifying River North Art District (RiNo). Thoughtfully expanded and tastefully enhanced, this home blends timeless character with modern comfort. Step inside to discover newly refinished hardwood floors that flow throughout the main level, leading into a spacious and inviting layout. The formal dining room is a standout feature—perfect for entertaining—with seating for 14+ guests and a convenient built-in linen closet. The kitchen offers both style and warmth, featuring granite countertops, solid cherry cabinetry, and a cozy seating area anchored by a charming wood-burning fireplace—perfect for creating that inviting country kitchen feel. The former sunroom has been seamlessly integrated into the home, now serving as a bright and versatile living space complete with tile flooring and in-floor radiant heat. From here, step out onto the covered patio—ideal for relaxing or entertaining year-round. The main floor includes a private primary suite with an en-suite bath, along with two additional bedrooms and a full bathroom. Downstairs, the finished lower level expands your living space with a large family room featuring a wet bar, a full bathroom with a jetted tub, and a dedicated office that can easily be converted into a fourth bedroom. You will also find a generous laundry room, cedar closet, and abundant storage. Additional highlights include a two-car attached garage, a south-facing drive that can accommodate 8 cars off street and fenced RV/boat parking. This unbeatable location just minutes from premier shopping, dining, top-rated schools, Larimer Street's dense mural walls, and the A Line commuter rail. This is a rare opportunity to own a move-in-ready home in one of Denver's most vibrant neighborhoods.

Back on the market at no fault of the sellers. The previous buyers' home sale fell apart, creating a rare second chance at a property that already had strong demand. This reimagined industrial loft stands out for both its design and its scale. With over 4,300 finished square feet, 5 bedrooms, and 5 bathrooms, the layout offers a level of flexibility that is hard to replicate and truly supports multi-generational living without compromise. The kitchen anchors the home with a clean, modern design featuring slab-front cabinetry, striking stone countertops, a gas range, and an oversized island built for gathering. Vaulted ceilings and expansive windows bring in natural light, giving the home an open, airy feel while still maintaining warmth and character. What truly sets this home apart is how naturally it accommodates separate living arrangements. With multiple living areas, private bedroom suites, and distinct zones throughout, extended family, long-term guests, or live-in support can have their own space while still feeling connected. Whether it is aging parents, returning adult children, or simply a need for more privacy, the layout delivers options that most homes cannot. The 2013 expansion adds both square footage and versatility, blending seamlessly with the original industrial architecture and enhancing the home's ability to function for a variety of living situations. Set on approximately one-third of an acre, the outdoor space is a standout feature. The south-facing backyard is a gardener's dream, offering abundant sunlight, mature landscaping, and the kind of exposure that makes growing and enjoying the space effortless. It is equally suited for relaxing afternoons or hosting, with a sense of privacy that is hard to find this close to RiNo, Larimer Street, and everyday conveniences. Homes with this level of architectural character, square footage, and true multi-generational flexibility rarely hit the market and even more rarely come back around.
